source_snapshot.procedure: Use ITP topology/port map, halt Windows and inject `errType='ce'` at unresolved socket/port targets.
source_snapshot.criteria: Normal operation, optional BMC/UEFI PCIe CE and front-panel light off.
source_snapshot.deepseek: PARTIAL; memory/EDAC grep is not a PCIe CE oracle.
source_snapshot.gpt_v2: Requires physical-to-logical map, PCIe-specific evidence and endpoint recovery.

old_problem: No mapping joined each physical slot to endpoint/root-port BDF and Cscript target, while optional management logs and memory-keyword collection left no mandatory PCIe CE oracle.
disposition_reason: PCIe CE semantics and required healthy outcome are standard enough to define a review-layer test; unstable BDF/port identities, endpoint usage and vendor injector syntax are runtime bindings under ED-03. A mandatory Cscript plus Windows PCIe WHEA/AER event replaces the mismatched EDAC grep, with BMC/UEFI retained when applicable. ED-16 keeps injection gated and operator-controlled.
decision_basis: Read XLSX row 30, same-row AI fields, historical record 2434 and next pending row 31.
Preserved independent slot 1~N coverage and did not reuse OCP/UCE/DPC/PCH evidence.
Required a fresh slot→endpoint→root-port→Cscript chain for every target.
Made endpoint/link health and CE-specific evidence mandatory despite optional management logging.
No fault injection or DUT command was run.

test_case.purpose: For each approved PCIe slot, deliver one mapped correctable error and prove PCIe-specific reporting without link, device, service or indicator impairment.
required_package: Supported ITP/CScripts hash and CE contract
Windows WHEA/AER plus health and applicable BMC/UEFI oracle
test_case.test_command: Capture current topology and endpoint/link/driver baseline, quiesce the approved endpoint, and have the FAE run one signed `injectPcieError(...,errType='ce')` at the mapped root port. Correlate the full transcript with Windows PCIe CE, optional management records, front-panel state and post-event link/device/service health, then restore settings.
test_case.expected_result: Every required slot produces the intended correctable PCIe event at the mapped hierarchy; link and endpoint remain healthy, service is uninterrupted, the fault light stays off, applicable management records agree and baseline is restored.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: PASS requires complete slot coverage, verified mapping, exact CE transcript, mandatory PCIe WHEA/AER evidence and unchanged link/device/service health. Generic corrected/EDAC logs, a guessed port, wrong slot, link reset/down or fatal escalation fails.
safety_gate: No injection into an active storage, network, GPU or management dependency until quiesced and approved.
Refresh topology immediately before each single target.
Abort on mapping drift, wrong severity, retrain/down, reset, service impact or escalation.
expected_evidence: Endpoint manifest, package hash and precheck
Complete injection and Windows PCIe CE transcript
Link/device/service health, optional BMC/UEFI and light-off proof
test_case.recovery: On any anomaly, stop coverage, retain logs and use the approved OOB procedure to recover the affected endpoint/platform; restore BIOS and verify every dependent service before further authorization.

source_conflict.reason: The review establishes a mandatory PCIe-specific oracle and makes physical/logical mapping an explicit runtime prerequisite.

blocked.reason: Safe method, oracle and recovery are defined; project target identities do not keep the review pending.
